items.desc: The drone, which is believed to have entered Lithuanian airspace from Belarus, was shot down by an Italian fighter jet in between the cities of Vilnius and Kaunas. There have been no reports of casualties or damage.

items.title: Russian warship fires flares at Danish helicopter
items.titleOrig: Russian warship fires flares at Danish helicopter
items.desc: Denmark has summoned Russia's ambassador over a Baltic Sea encounter that Copenhagen says is part of an increasingly aggressive pattern of Russian behavior.

items.title: China tightens travel rules over tech security
items.titleOrig: China tightens travel rules over tech security
items.desc: Beijing says the new rules, which could also apply to foreign and Taiwanese nationals, are aimed at safeguarding "national security."

items.title: Netherlands: Suspected sabotage disrupts train services
items.titleOrig: Netherlands: Suspected sabotage disrupts train services
items.desc: A major outage has hit parts of the Dutch railway system after objects were found placed across lines, authorities say. The company responsible for rail infrastructure says it suspects deliberate wrongdoing.

items.title: India: Meta to report child abuse cases to law enforcement
items.titleOrig: India: Meta to report child abuse cases to law enforcement
items.desc: Tech giant Meta will now directly report child safety-related cases to India's cybercrime portal, according to media reports. DW has more.

items.title: Why top AI researchers are warning about human extinction
items.titleOrig: Why top AI researchers are warning about human extinction
items.desc: Could artificial intelligence pose an existential threat to humanity? Some leading researchers are warning against an unregulated race toward AI superintelligence.

items.title: El Salvador court hands down first life sentence for femicide
items.titleOrig: El Salvador court hands down first life sentence for femicide
items.desc: The landmark conviction comes 42 days after the killing of a woman in Santa Ana who prosecutors said was stalked and harassed by her neighbor.

items.title: Iran and America: A tale of two lands and the pistachio between them
items.titleOrig: Iran and America: A tale of two lands and the pistachio between them
items.desc: The pistachios sold across the US have a surprising history: California's trees trace their roots to Iran. Now both regions face the same threat: their farmland is sinking as groundwater disappears.

items.title: US confirms it has weapons in space
items.titleOrig: US confirms it has weapons in space
items.desc: The US Space Force justified the weapons deployment by citing its two biggest geopolitical rivals — Russia and China. Beijing responded by urging Washington to "stop preparing for war" in outer space.

items.title: Europe launches two climate observation satellites
items.titleOrig: Europe launches two climate observation satellites
items.desc: The European Space Agency has put two satellites into orbit to take a closer look at the impact of climate change. One of them will focus particularly on plant life.

items.title: US scraps greenhouse gas rules for power plants
items.titleOrig: US scraps greenhouse gas rules for power plants
items.desc: The Environmental Protection Agency said it was repealing Biden-era limits on emissions made by power plants, in the "largest power sector deregulation action ever."

items.title: US Supreme Court denies Trump bid to restrict mail-in ballots
items.titleOrig: US Supreme Court denies Trump bid to restrict mail-in ballots
items.desc: The court said election officials do not have sufficient time to implement the rule before the November midterms. Trump has argued, without providing evidence, that the system is vulnerable to fraud.

items.title: Germany news: Merz urges CDU discipline as pressure grows
items.titleOrig: Germany news: Merz urges CDU discipline as pressure grows
items.desc: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has urged his party to stay disciplined as pressure grows over his leadership. Meanwhile, Germany's homeownership rate has fallen to its lowest level in 20 years.

items.title: Kremlin-linked Russian oligarch helped fund Trump Jr.'s wedding celebration
items.titleOrig: Kremlin-linked Russian oligarch helped fund Trump Jr.'s wedding celebration
items.desc: Trump's son and his wife confirmed reports that Umar Kremlev paid for parts of the festivities. Kremlev was awarded the "Order of Friendship" by Putin earlier this year.

items.title: EU seeks Arctic strategy amid growing power rivalry
items.titleOrig: EU seeks Arctic strategy amid growing power rivalry
items.desc: Russia's aggression, Trump's threats against Greenland and the race for critical raw materials are pushing the Arctic to the top of Europe's agenda.

items.title: Ukraine, Russia set for new round of US-mediated talks
items.titleOrig: Ukraine, Russia set for new round of US-mediated talks
items.desc: New trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US could begin in October, according to Kyiv and Moscow. Few expect a breakthrough, but Ukraine is seeking a partial de-escalation to help it get through the winter.

items.title: Trump seeks halt to energy attacks by both Russia, Ukraine
items.titleOrig: Trump seeks halt to energy attacks by both Russia, Ukraine
items.desc: Donald Trump, under fire for record US diesel prices, claims Russia and Ukraine have agreed to stop striking energy targets. Russia said nothing; Ukraine said "we expect specifics from our partners" on any such move.

items.title: Donald Trump dismisses concerns about dangers of AI
items.titleOrig: Donald Trump dismisses concerns about dangers of AI
items.desc: The president called efforts to slow the development of artificial intelligence a "sick conspiracy," claiming they only serve China. Market leaders have warned of the dangers of the pace of the technology's development.

items.title: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudis, seize crucial Red Sea islands
items.titleOrig: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudis, seize crucial Red Sea islands
items.desc: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have tightened their grip on a key shipping route, capturing two strategic Red Sea islands. The closure of another global transport route is the latest ripple effect of the US war with Iran.

items.title: Women's Basketball World Cup: Can Germany harness a boom?
items.titleOrig: Women's Basketball World Cup: Can Germany harness a boom?
items.desc: Germany thrilled fans at the Women's Basketball World Cup. But even if this sparked a boom in the women's game, the infrastructure simply isn't ready for it.
